    Okay, jokes aside for a second.

    Being your older brother means I get to annoy you, make fun of you, give you unwanted advice, and act like I know everything.

    Which, obviously, I do.

    But it also means I get to watch you grow up, cheer you on, be there when things get difficult, and see all the amazing things you're going to do.

    I might not say it every day, but I'm really glad I get to be your brother.

    Here's a little secret.

    Even when we tease you, argue with you, or tell you to stop doing something for the hundredth time...

    You're surrounded by people who love you more than you probably realise.

    You're growing up, and there are so many exciting things ahead of you. But wherever life takes you, you'll always have your people.

    And you'll always have me.

    A little letter, just for you

    Dear Chiku,

    Happy 11th birthday, you little weirdo. ❤️

    I know I spend a lot of time annoying you, making fun of you, and pretending you're the most irritating person in the world. And, to be fair, you do make a very strong case for that.

    But underneath all the teasing, I hope you know how much you mean to me.

    I hope you grow up doing things that make you happy. I hope you stay curious, keep laughing at silly things, try things that scare you a little, and never feel like you have to pretend to be someone you're not.

    There will be days when things don't go your way, and days when it feels like nobody gets you. When those days come, remember that you never have to figure everything out alone. That's literally what I'm here for.

    I'll always be rooting for you. I'll celebrate your wins, help you through the hard bits, and probably still annoy you while doing it.

    You're only eleven once. Enjoy it. Make ridiculous memories. Laugh until your stomach hurts. Be kind to people. And never be afraid to dream big.

    I'm really lucky to be your brother.

    Happy birthday, Chiku.
    Love you, always. ❤️

    Make a wish first. Then blow out the candles. 🌬️

    Keep being funny. Keep being curious. Keep being wonderfully, ridiculously YOU.

    And just so we're clear...

    You're stuck with me as your older brother. FOREVER.

    Love you, idiot. ❤️
